handoff.state_evidence: Closed state requires visible lid components and body; renderer derives the visible and isolated state masks and rejects ineligible labels. Evidence pixels and quality are unknown until an authorized render.

open_and_other_gaps: This declaration includes closed only; existing arena open-state suppression remains unchanged.
